features.title: ENGINEERED CAPABILITIES
features.subtitle: Full-spectrum creative engineering designed to scale modern enterprises.

items.title: Tactile Glass Design Systems

items.title: Real-Time Content Engine

items.title: Autonomous Web Core

items.title: Protected Admin Vault

items.title: Spatial UI Infrastructure
items.description: 3D viewport tilt surfaces, responsive grid layouts, and spring-physics animations built for modern web displays.

items.title: Global High-Availability
items.description: Zero-downtime architecture designed to handle peak viral traffic spikes with fluid fallback rendering.
